patch_resolves_note: The staged patch moves `xmlFree(guess);` below the unsupported-encoding error report, so the fixed build can still raise the same error while `guess` remains live through `htmlParseErr()` and `__xmlRaiseError()`.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `guess` must still refer to live heap storage when `htmlParseErr(ctxt, XML_ERR_INVALID_ENCODING, "Unsupported encoding %s", guess, NULL)` executes.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the unsupported-encoding error path reuses `guess` as the `%s` argument, the same `guess` pointer must not already have been released by `xmlFree(guess)` in the current `htmlCurrentChar()` invocation.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches `htmlParseErr(..., guess, NULL)` after freeing the same `guess` pointer, while the fixed original reaches the same error path before the moved `xmlFree(guess);` executes.

nodes.state: The vulnerable `xmlFree(guess);` releases the same heap buffer later reused by the unsupported-encoding error path.
At `XML_GET_VAR_STR(msg, str);`, `__xmlRaiseError()` formats the forwarded `str1` pointer as the first `%s` argument for the unsupported-encoding message.

edges.relation: The exact pointer released by `xmlFree(guess)` is later reused as the `guess` argument in the unsupported-encoding `htmlParseErr()` call.
The unsupported-encoding call forwards the same `guess` pointer into `htmlParseErr()` as parameter `str1`.
The same `str1` pointer forwarded by `htmlParseErr()` is received by `__xmlRaiseError()` and consumed at the formatter sink.
